title: This week in Lagos: ART X, the Fringe and opera at MUSON
dek: ART X opens today, Lagos Fringe fills Onikan all weekend, and Saturday ends with opera.
intro: ART X Lagos opens today and runs to Sunday. On Saturday, the Fringe has shows from ₦2,000 at J. Randle Centre, then Opera in Concert at MUSON at 6 PM.
Sunday night closes the Fringe with a free performance.

title: Grants and fellowships closing this month
dek: Twelve funded calls with November deadlines, from a £20,000 film fund to a $100,000 eco prize.
intro: November is heavy on deadlines. Start with the ones closing first and work down.
Every call links to the official page. Apply there.

title: Accra in November: a marathon, Tech in Ghana and Frederick Okai
dek: Run the 35th Accra Marathon, catch Okai's sculpture at Nubuke, and two days of Tech in Ghana.
intro: Accra's November runs from the marathon on the 14th to Tech in Ghana on the 24th.
Nubuke Foundation's new show opens on the 11th and stays up until April.

title: Abuja's big weekend: Afrojazz and Arewa Festival
dek: Jazz by Jabi Lake and two days of Northern food, fashion and crafts on 21 to 22 November.
intro: 21 November is Abuja's weekend: the Afrojazz main concert and the first day of Arewa Festival.
Wizkid follows at Eagle Square on 13 December.

title: Detty December 2026: the dates so far
dek: Wizkid opens Detty December Fest in Lagos, then Detty Rave and AfroFuture in Accra.
intro: The confirmed December dates so far, across Lagos, Abuja and Accra.
Buy tickets only from official sellers.

title: Entertainment Week Africa: what is free and what to book
dek: Free opening and runway nights, Jokes n Jollof, and the Livespot X Festival close.
intro: EWA runs 17 to 22 November across Lekki and Victoria Island.
Two nights are free. Book Jokes n Jollof and Livespot X early.
